name: Vidrà (Spain)
description: Green field with a white sprig of three leaves at the centre and three juxtaposed stripes near the lower edge, white, black and white.
history: The flag was approved on 6 April 1994 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, green, with three juxtaposed fesses white, black and white, the white ones 1/24 of the height and the black 1/12, placed 1/12 from the lower edge.
